description: This file defines a serializer for the .NET DateTime struct within the Orleans serialization framework. It implements methods to serialize and deserialize DateTime objects to and from a binary wire format, and includes low-level methods for writing and reading DateTime values with type safety and performance optimizations.

classes.name: DateTimeCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IDFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing DateTime objects efficiently within Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField (instance method)
methods.description: Serializes a DateTime value into the provided buffer writer, including field header and binary data.

methods.name: WriteField (static method)
methods.description: Static method to serialize a DateTime value without type info, optimized for known expected type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a DateTime value from a reader, ensuring correct wire type and binary data.
